oneLine: Sazerac acquires a 66 percent majority stake in John Distilleries, replacing Paul John Fund LLC.

sources.title: John Distilleries surpasses Rs 10,000 crore revenue in FY26; Sazerac become majority shareholder

synopsis: Global spirits major Sazerac has acquired a 66 percent majority stake in Bengaluru-based liquor maker John Distilleries Ltd, replacing Paul John Fund LLC as the controlling shareholder. Paul John Fund LLC, an entity owned by founder and promoter Paul P John, now holds the remaining 34 percent shareholding. The transaction represents a complete reversal of the previous ownership structure, where Paul John Fund LLC held 66 percent and Sazerac held 34 percent. Meanwhile, John Distilleries reported a revenue of Rs 10,820.10 crore and a net profit of Rs 11.6 crore for FY26.
